分割图像合成工作流程

大家好，这是我的第一个工作流程。

我在玩 ComfyUI 时做到了这一点，但我分享它是为了其他人可能会发现它有用:)

这并不是什么非常创新的东西，但它的创造是有教育意义的，因为我学到了不同有趣的东西。

它是如何工作的（+版本说明）

简单易行。您从左侧前两个 CLIP 文本编码上的正面和负面提示开始（绿色表示正面，红色表示负面）


工作流程的初始阶段涉及生成基本的第一张图像，该图像受到提供的两个提示和左侧第一个 Ksampler 的强烈影响。因此，您可以通过调整工作流程初始阶段的参数来控制初始图像。

然后生成的图像进入 ControlNet 部分，提取主要结构。工作流程使用精明的配备 Canny 边缘处理器，但请随意尝试，特别是如果你正在和人一起玩，你可以尝试开放姿势.


在接下来的工作流程中，ControlNet 预处理图像进入两个不同的 Ksampler，这两个 Ksampler 完全独立并受各自提示的影响。

上面的一个控制图像的左半部分，下面的一个控制图像的右半部分。调整这两个 Ksampler 的参数并使用这两个提示（蓝色提示），您可以控制两个半图像。

在工作流程结束时，这两个图像会连接在一起。

就是这样。


注意：

的基础版无法在每一半中选择不同的型号，而半模型选择器版本允许您为每一半单独选择不同的模型。但你可以轻松地选择半模型选择器只需为两半选择相同的型号即可。所以我的建议是无论如何都下载半模型选择器.

示例

让我们举一个简单的例子，不要过多考虑提示工程，只是为了了解它是如何工作的。


主要积极提示

山上小镇的照片

左半提示

在一个阳光明媚的日子

右半提示

在一个下雪天

所以我们得到的是：

主图（将用于 ControlNet 步骤）

ControlNet Canny 预处理图像

半左图，使用 Half Left Ksampler 和 Half Left Prompt 生成

半右图像，使用 Half Right Ksampler 和 Half Right Prompt 生成

最终结果

在本示例中，我使用了 DreamShaper，没有使用 LoRa，但您可以尝试一下。

自定义节点

此工作流程使用您需要的两个自定义节点：

 ComfyUI 的 ControlNet 辅助预处理器需要管理从第一个生成的图像中提取结构的 ControlNet 部分。

Comfy_KepListStuff在工作流程的最后用于将两个半图像连接在一起（如果有不同的方法来执行此操作，请告诉我，因为我仍在学习 ComfyUI）

更新

[2023.12.03] 在 zip 中添加了另一个工作流程文件。与第一个工作流程相同，不同之处在于，使用这个新工作流程，图像可以分割为 4 个四等分

Split Image Composition Workflow

Hi guys, this is my first workflow.

I did it while playing around myself with ComfyUI but I'm sharing it in the case someone else could find it useful :)

It's nothing extremly innovative, but it has been educative to create, since I've learned different interesting stuff.

How it Works (+ versions note)

Easy peasy. You start with your positive and negative prompt on the first two CLIP Text Encodings from the left (green for positive and red for negative)


The initial stage of the workflow involves generating a basic first image, that is strongly influenced by the two provided prompts and the first Ksampler from the left. So you can get the control over the initial image by adjusting the parameters in this initial stage of the workflow.

The generated image then goes into the ControlNet section that extract the main structure. The workflow usesCannywith Canny Edge Processor,but feel free to play around with that, especlially if you're playing with person, you can try withOpenPose.


In the next of the workflow, that ControlNet preprocessed image goes into two different Ksampler that are totally indipendent and influenced by their own prompt.

The upper one control the left half of the image, and the bottom one control the right half of the image. Adjusting the parameters of those two Ksampler and playing around with those two prompts (the blue ones) you can get the control over the two half images.

At the end of the workflow, those two images get concatenated togheter.

That's it.


NOTE:

TheBasic Versiondo not have the possibility to select a different model the each half, while theHalf Model Selectorversion allows you to select a different model for each half individually. But you can easly go with theHalf Model Selectorand simply select the same model for both the half. Somy suggestion is to downaload the Half Model Selector in any case.

Examples

Let's make an easy example, without thinking too much about the prompt engineering, just to understand how it works.


Main Positivie Prompt

A photo of a mountains small town

Left Half Prompt

in a sunny day

Right Half Prompt

in a snowy day

So here what we get:

Main image(that will be used for the ControlNet Step)

ControlNet Canny PreProcessed Image

Half Letf Image, generated with the Half Left Ksampler with the Half Left Prompt

Half Right Image, generated with the Half Right Ksampler with the Half Right Prompt

Final Results

For this example I've used DreamShaper and no LoRa but you can play around with that.

Custom Nodes

This workflow uses two custom nodes you need to have:

 ComfyUI's ControlNet Auxiliary Preprocessorsneeded to manage the ControlNet part that extract the structure from the first generated image.

Comfy_KepListStuffused at the very end of the workflow to concatenate the two half images toghether (if there is a different way to do this, please, let me know, since I'm still learning about ComfyUI)

Updates

[2023.12.03] Added another workflow file to the zip. Is the same than the first workflow, with the difference that with this new workflow the image can be splitted in 4 quartes
